description: This file provides a utility enum 'MicRefreshSupport' that manages microphone refresh behaviors, including starting observers, scheduling refresh tasks, selecting microphone names, and binding voice wake state to the app's state. It integrates with Swift concurrency and SwiftUI.

methods.name: startObserver
methods.description: Starts observing an audio input device and triggers a refresh callback when the observer detects changes.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a refresh action to be performed after a delay, cancelling any previous scheduled task.

methods.name: selectedMicName
methods.description: Selects the microphone name from a list of device objects based on the selected device ID.

methods.name: voiceWakeBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding for voice wake enablement status to synchronize with AppState.
